verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists connectors that sync code-repository issue trackers with Asana tasks in both directions: GitLab 2-way sync, Bitbucket issue/comment/assignee sync, and one- or two-way sync with GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps. The evidence consists only of one-line directory blurbs, which appear to describe marketplace connectors rather than a documented first-party feature, so depth and reliability are unproven. The GitHub-specific item covers only one-way PR status updates. Missing for 10: confirmation that these are first-party Asana capabilities, documentation of field mapping and conflict handling, two-way GitHub issue sync evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data

citations.quote: Turn GitLab issues into Asana tasks and back with real-time 2-way sync without writing a single line of code.
Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project. Keep teams aligned with automated one-way or two-way data synchronization
Integrate Bitbucket with Asana to sync issues, tasks, projects, repos, comments, assignees, custom fields, and more, automatically.
Automatically sync GitHub pull request status updates to Asana tasks.
